info.title: Ideaproxima API
info.description: A collective repository of humanity's possible futures. Recorded facts are append-only; derived values name the algorithm that produced them.

idea.description: The idea `ideaId` refers to, for display; null when none or hidden.

AddClaimRequest.description: Provide exactly one of `claimId` (link an existing claim) or `statement` (state a new one).

AttachEvidenceRequest.description: Provide exactly one basis: `sourceId`, `source` (registered or matched by DOI/URL) or `outcomeId`.

token.description: Session token. Also set as the HttpOnly `ip_session` cookie.

body.description: Empty when hidden by moderation (the comment keeps its place in the thread).

supersededAt.description: Set when the evaluator re-rated or withdrew.

limitations.description: What this evidence does NOT establish.

updatedAt.description: When the current revision was published.

sections.description: Markdown. `[text](claim:<id>)` links anchor prose to claims.

updatedAt.description: When the current revision was published.

phrase.description: The relation read from the focal idea, e.g. "is required by".

attention.description: People who marked the idea important. Popularity — not quality.

contestation.description: Widest disagreement among confidently rated dimensions (0–0.5).

active.description: False when deactivated by moderation. Contributions stay attributed.

contributions.description: Plain counts of recorded contributions — not a quality measure.

mean.description: Mean on the dimension's native scale (e.g. 1–5).

dispersion.description: Normalised spread: 0 = full agreement, 0.5 = maximal split.

n.description: Number of current ratings. Below 3, show 'too early to tell'.

changed.description: Dimensions recorded; empty when the submission repeated current ratings.

ideaCount.description: Visible ideas in this topic or its direct children.

latestIdeas.description: Up to two newest visible ideas in this topic or its direct children, newest first.
